verdict: Maybe, for a founder with textile or technology depth. TURMS pitched stain-proof, odour-resistant 'intelligent' clothing on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Performance fabrics can command higher prices, but you must prove the claims and they must last through washing.
angle: Office workers pay more for shirts that resist stains, sweat and wrinkles. The value is in fabric technology, often licensed or sourced from specialist mills. Your claims will be tested by every buyer, so test carefully and explain them simply.
